sample_mapping_evidence: 35 unique explicit patient IDs in original PBMC expression records; paired BCR/TCR assays excluded. Preserve admission window without inventing exact days.

source_processing: Basecalls and mapping performed using Cell Ranger ver 6.0
Supplementary files format and content: TCR and BCR VDJ, barcodes, features and matrix tsv files

title: Expression, patient 1
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMC samples recovered from COVID-19 patients at admission (n=13) or within 10 days after admission (n=8), were stained with anti-human CD45 antibody. Propidium iodine was also added to samples to remove dead cells. Live CD45+ cells were sorted using a SONY SH800S (4,000-10,000 cells each, cell viability >98%) and then encapsulated into droplets.

Libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 3’ Reagent Kits v3.1 following the manufacturer’s protocol (10X Genomics, CA, USA). The generated scRNA-seq libraries were sequenced using a total of 127 cycles (paired-end reads) with a NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina, Inc., CA, USA)
Single cell RNA-seq, Single cell TCR and BCT V(D)J segments (scVDJ-seq)
data_processing: Basecalls and mapping performed using Cell Ranger ver 6.0
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: TCR and BCR VDJ, barcodes, features and matrix tsv files

Libraries were prepared using Chromium Single Cell 3’ Reagent Kits v3.1 following the manufacturer’s protocol (10X Genomics, CA, USA). The generated scRNA-seq libraries were sequenced using a total of 127 cycles (paired-end reads) with a NovaSeq 6000 (Illumina, Inc., CA, USA)
Single cell RNA-seq, Single cell TCR and BCT V(D)J segments (scVDJ-seq)
data_processing: Basecalls and mapping performed using Cell Ranger ver 6.0
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: TCR and BCR VDJ, barcodes, features and matrix tsv files
